claims: The 2026 NCAA Men's Division I Ice Hockey Championship is also called "Frozen Four".
The 2026 NCAA Men's Division I Ice Hockey Championship is taking place at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas, Nevada.
The title game of the 2026 NCAA Men's Division I Ice Hockey Championship concludes on Saturday, April 11, 2026.
The 2026 NCAA Men's Division I Ice Hockey Championship features a 16-team tournament field.
The final of the 2026 NCAA Men's Division I Ice Hockey Championship is set to feature the Wisconsin Badgers against the winner of the Denver vs. Michigan semifinal.
Wisconsin secured a spot in the final of the 2026 Frozen Four with a 2-1 win over North Dakota.
Denver defeated Michigan 4-3 in double overtime to advance to the final of the 2026 Frozen Four.
The national championship game of the 2026 Frozen Four is scheduled for April 11, 2026.
Every game of the 2026 Frozen Four tournament can be seen on the ESPN networks.
Wisconsin beat North Dakota 2-1 in Semifinal 1 of the 2026 Frozen Four.
Wisconsin's appearance in the 2026 Frozen Four final is their first since 2010.
Denver outlasted Michigan 4-3 in double overtime in Semifinal 2 of the 2026 Frozen Four.
Denver goalie Johnny Hicks recorded 49 saves in the semifinal victory over Michigan in the 2026 Frozen Four.
Western Michigan was the 2025 NCAA Hockey Champion.
Denver was the 2024 NCAA Hockey Champion.
Quinnipiac was the 2023 NCAA Hockey Champion.
Denver was the 2022 NCAA Hockey Champion.
